label: SIMULATION: nodes, links and delays are simulated. Link delays are configured settings (B's links are set cheaper than D's), not measurements.

gateway.network_view: stale: nothing has arrived from C since the link was lost

delivered_late.known_by: C (held while the controller was unreachable)

lost_at_c.known_by: C's status (waiting readings it gave up) and the controller (readings sent once and never acknowledged)

lost_total.known_by: A (telemetry) plus C and the controller

frames.source: simulation: frame bytes come from the simulator's codec, not from a radio

recent.summary: created 4, acknowledged 2, no route 2, forwarded 18, dropped 5

presenter.note: What the presenter did to the simulated environment. This is not something the controller knows.

data.label: Detach the gateway (injected by presenter, simulation)
